name: Ca Mau
provinceNote: Since 1 July 2025, Cà Mau is the former Cà Mau and Bạc Liêu provinces together. Resolution 202/2025/QH15, clause 22, passed on 12 June 2025, prints 7,942.39 km² and 2,606,672 people and borders An Giang, Cần Thơ, and the East Sea. The clause does not name a capital.
dotReason: The southern cape, the marker and the two seas, is worth the road from Cần Thơ.
summary: A Mekong Delta city at Vietnam’s southern tip, the base for the mangrove cape where two seas meet. Stand at the marker on the southern tip, travel through the mangroves at Nam Can, walk the granite rocks of Hon Da Bac, and eat mangrove crab. Suits travellers who want to reach the far end of the Mekong Delta.
timeNeeded: One night in the city, a road day south
fee: No single city ticket. The cape gate figures disagree. Check on arrival.
getThere: Ca Mau airport (CAH), or the expressway from Can Tho. Clocks disagree.
seoTitle: Ca Mau city guide — the Dat Mui cape and the two seas
seoDescription: Stay in the city and ride south to Đất Mũi, where the East Sea and the West Sea meet. The Cần Thơ expressway is 110.85 km. The cape-gate hours disagree.
intro: The granite you can walk is Hòn Đá Bạc, on the Gulf, about 6.43 hectares and three rocks, the highest about 50 meters. The national tourism extract puts it at xóm Kinh Hòn, xã Khánh Bình Tây, huyện Trần Văn Thời, about 50 km by water and 42 km by road. The relic page says ấp Kênh Hòn, xã Đá Bạc, and the airline guide says about 50 km. The road runs toward U Minh Hạ, then Nông trường Minh Hà, Cơi Năm, and ấp Đá Bạc B, then one bridge onto the rock. Official pages print no fee. Two tour pages print 20,000 VND for an adult and 10,000 VND for a child. One tour page prints 07:00–19:00. Check on arrival. This rock is not the melaleuca at U Minh Hạ.

You wake in the city and ride south. The picture at the end of the road is the ship-shaped panel, in place from the end of 2020, or the GPS0001 marker that closes đường Hồ Chí Minh, with mangrove or mudflat and the sea in the same view. The Ngọc Hiển page of 23 August 2024 prints the line “Tổ quốc tôi như một con tàu / Mũi thuyền ta đó Mũi Cà Mau” on that panel, the sail text “Mũi Cà Mau”, and the coordinates on it, 8°37'30" north and 104°43' east. Work on the road-end marker started on 15 February 2017, at an investment of about 70 billion đồng. The same page names the sea wall and Cột cờ Hà Nội, and it says you look at the place where the East Sea and the West Sea meet. UNESCO describes the tip as the place two tidal regimes meet and new mudflats form. The Ramsar news page prints a wetland point of 08°41'00"N 104°47'32"E. Neither reading is the city center. Sleep in the river wards the city list prints as phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành, beside the older phường numbers. A night at ấp Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, is the other bed, and only when the dawn inside the gate is the point. The evening is the city river and the Gành Hào boats. Stay when the cape is the trip. Go to Cần Thơ when that river city is the trip.

The culture-office listing for the national park, which shares the Đất Mũi address, prints 15,000–30,000 VND and hours 07:00–18:00, and says time at one point is not limited. A tour page dated 30 September 2026 prints the gate at 06:30–17:30 every day including Tết, adult 30,000 VND, a child from 1 m to 1.3 m and students at 15,000 VND, and no ticket under 1 m or for a severe disability. The hours disagree. The price band matches, and the office page does not split adult and child. An electric cart at 10,000–15,000 VND a person, and canoe trips at about 600,000–800,000 VND for a short ride or about 1,200,000–1,600,000 VND for a long ride, for a boat of 6–8 people, are only on that tour page. The office listing does not confirm them. Check on arrival. The same tour page prefers 08:00–10:00 and after 15:00, and says a departure from the city after 13:00 misses the gate. The office listing does not print that advice. The expressway ends at nút giao IC12, xã Hồ Thị Kỷ, and motorbikes are not allowed on it. The cape road is the one south of Năm Căn.

The mangrove behind the tip is Vườn quốc gia Mũi Cà Mau. Decision 142/2003/QĐ-TTg of 14 July 2003 upgraded it from the Đất Mũi nature reserve of Decision 194/CT on 9 August 1986. The conservation page prints an area over 41,800 hectares. The Ramsar sheet prints 41,862 hectares, about 13,400 hectares of mangrove and about 26,000 hectares of mudflat. The opened information sheet prints the designation date 13/12/12 and site number 2088. The Ramsar news page is dated 27 November 2012. The conservation page says the park was recognized as a Ramsar site in 2013. 12 December 2013 is also printed. UNESCO names this park, U Minh Hạ, and the west-coast belt as cores of the 2009 biosphere reserve. U Minh Hạ is the other forest, north of the city at ấp Vồ Dơi, xã Đá Bạc: melaleuca on peat, a different gate from the cape, and a different park from U Minh Thượng. The park homepage prints no fee and no hour. One commercial page prints 10,000 VND and 07:30–17:00. Another prints about 30,000–50,000 VND. A third prints 07:20–17:00. Boat prices on those commercial pages are 150,000 VND a person an hour or 80,000 VND for 30 minutes. The homepage does not confirm them. Distance on those pages is about 40 km and about 1 hour, or about 35 km and about 50 minutes to 1 hour. A visit of half a day to two days is on commercial pages only. The homepage prints no stay. Check on arrival, and do not choose one fee or one clock.

In town, the morning is the river. UNESCO puts a floating market of hundreds of boats on the Gành Hào, in the center. The city handbook also names the market and prints no hour. Check on arrival. The Cần Thơ dawn is a different market. Chùa Monivongsa Bopharam is on đường Đinh Tiên Hoàng, phường 1, also printed as phường An Xuyên. Chùa bà Thiên Hậu is at số 77 Ngô Quyền, phường 9, also printed as phường An Xuyên. UNESCO names Quan Âm Cổ Tự, chùa Hưng Quang, and đền Tân Hưng separately. The provincial museum has two addresses on the pages opened: số 221 Ngô Quyền, phường 1, on the heritage directory, and số 1AB Lý Văn Lâm, phường 1, the working office since a provincial decision of 11 August 2021. The history-museum article says there is still no real museum building and that public displays are few. Hours were not printed. Check on arrival. Nhà thờ Giáo xứ Cà Mau prints 68 Lê Lợi, phường 2, in the heading and 200/20 Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, in the body. Eat crab or salted ba khía with rice. The Ngọc Hiển page calls meat crab firm and sweet and roe crab full and rich. No restaurant street was named, and no stall price was printed.
gettingAround: Cảng hàng không Cà Mau, IATA CAH, is the airport. The Vietnam Airlines ticket page, opened 22 October 2026, prints it in phường 6, about 10 km from the center and 20–30 minutes in, with reference fares of 60,000 VND by xe ôm and 150,000 VND by taxi, to be agreed before the ride. The airline’s 2025 airport guide prints a different pair: số 93 đường Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, and 2 km to the center, taxi 5–10 minutes and 70,000–100,000 VND, xe ôm 5–10 minutes and 20,000–40,000 VND. The ticket page and the 2025 guide do not match on distance, time, or fare. VietnamPlus on 9 October 2026 quotes the airport director: commercial flights resume 29 November 2026 after more than a year stopped for an upgrade, Vietnam Airlines on an A321, Ho Chi Minh City to Cà Mau 12:50–13:55, return 14:50–15:50, fare 924,000–964,000 VND including the ticketing fee. The ticket page still lists Ho Chi Minh City–Cà Mau as the only direct route being flown, about 1 hour 10 minutes, one flight a day, with sample fares from 955,181 VND and a later line from 1,206,000 VND, and seats on dates that include 28 November 2026. The 2025 guide still says VASCO flies the only route once a day on an ATR-72 or ATR-42, outbound 11:25 for about 1 hour, return 12:45 for about 1 hour. These pages do not agree on whether a commercial flight is running, or on the block time. Check the airline before you count on a seat. The pages print 1 hour, 1 hour 10 minutes, and the 12:50 departure. Connections via Tân Sơn Nhất on the ticket page are Hanoi about 4 hours 40 minutes to 7 hours 40 minutes, four flights a day, and Thanh Hóa about 4 hours 45 minutes, one flight a day. A Hanoi nonstop is a hope in the VietnamPlus piece, not a timetable. No ferry from this cape to Phú Quốc was on the pages opened.

There is no passenger station to take. Tuổi Trẻ on 10 October 2025 says the Mekong Delta has had no railway since the Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho line stopped in 1958. The pre-feasibility it describes runs 175.2 km from ga An Bình to ga Cần Thơ, through Ho Chi Minh City, Tây Ninh, Đồng Tháp, Vĩnh Long, and Cần Thơ, with twelve main stations, a hoped start at the end of 2027, and phase 1 basically finished in 2035. Cà Mau is not a station on that scheme. A later Cần Thơ–Cà Mau line is a hope in that article, not a decided alignment or a year. The usual previous stop is Cần Thơ, where the expressway ends. VietnamPlus and Tuổi Trẻ on 19 January 2026 print the length as 110.85 km. Pháp Luật / Tuổi Trẻ on 28 April 2026 prints nearly 111 km of main line and nearly 26 km of link roads. The line opened for traffic at 11:00 on 19 January 2026. The Hậu Giang–Cà Mau section is 73.2 km. The Cần Thơ–Hậu Giang section had been open since 22 December 2025. Speed is 80 km/h maximum and 60 km/h minimum. Motorbikes, bicycles, and people on foot are not allowed. The project board says the expressway cuts the Cần Thơ–Cà Mau ride to 1.5 hours, from 3 hours before. The Tuổi Trẻ headline that day says about 90 minutes. One driver that morning told the paper the ride took more than 1 hour 15 minutes. The project board, the headline, and that driver are three times. The 3 hours is the old ride on the project board, not a measured Quốc lộ 1 timetable. The Hậu Giang–Cà Mau section was paused on 16 March 2026 for unfinished drains, slopes, and shoulders. The project board said the full line would reopen at 11:30 on 29 April 2026. A later closure, after that April notice, was not on the pages opened on 22 October 2026. The Cần Thơ end is at phường Cái Răng, off the Nam Sông Hậu / Quốc lộ 91B road, near Cảng Cái Cui. The Cà Mau end is IC12, xã Hồ Thị Kỷ, on the southern coastal corridor the notices call đường Hành lang ven biển phía Nam, or đường Xuyên Á. The expressway does not reach Đất Mũi. VietnamPlus says the line has non-stop toll gates and does not print a toll. Check on arrival for the đồng amount. A kilometer for Quốc lộ 1 from Cần Thơ to the city, and a road duration from Ho Chi Minh City, were not on the airport, expressway, or tourism pages opened. Check on arrival.

South of the city, Báo Đầu tư on 29 November 2023 prints 58.7 km of đường Hồ Chí Minh, from cầu Ông Tình at Năm Căn to Khu du lịch Đất Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, huyện Ngọc Hiển. That project starts at Năm Căn, not at the city. Phase 1 was finished in 2016. The alignment is drawn as cấp III đồng bằng, design speed 80 km/h, and the article says the cross-section still matches cấp V, about 40 km/h, on a sealed coat. Four bridges, Rạch Tàu, Rạch Vàm, Xóm Mũi, and Rạch Bầu Nhỏ, are printed at a 60 km/h design. An upgrade to a real cấp III road was proposed at about 4,204.1 billion đồng, with a hoped finish in 2027 if approved. That 2027 date is the hope in a 2023 article. A Vietravel page says the cape is more than 100 km from the city, and that mũi Bãi Bùng is 34 km southwest of thị trấn Năm Căn. A tour page prints 100–110 km and 2.5–3.5 hours by road, more than 50 km and more than 1 hour on Quốc lộ 1 to Năm Căn, plus more than 50 km on the Hồ Chí Minh road. These are separate figures, not one official kilometer. A city-to-cape minute was not on the road-project page. The 2.5–3.5 hours is one tour page. Motorbikes can use this road. A canoe from Năm Căn is named on the tour page. No official canoe timetable or fare was opened. Check on arrival. One commercial page prints Bến xe Cà Mau on đường Lý Thường Kiệt, phường 6, phone 02903 811 063, about 9.3 km and about 15 minutes from the center, and local buses between the station and Năm Căn, Sông Đốc, Thới Bình, U Minh, Phước Long, and Ngã Năm, at 05:00–17:00 with a bus every 15 minutes. One source. Confirm the bay on arrival, and do not treat the 15 minutes as a provincial timetable. A 2026 public coach fare and a clock from Ho Chi Minh City or from Cần Thơ were not on that page. Check on arrival. Hòn Đá Bạc is about 50 km by water and 42 km by road on the national tourism extract, and about 50 km on the airline guide. Đầm Thị Tường is about 40 km on that same airline guide, one source. A city-center taxi fare that is not an airport ride was not printed. Check on arrival. A month when the expressway or the cape road closes was not on the pages opened. Check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: River wards
stayAreas.summary: Sleep in the city, in the river wards the city list prints as phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành, beside the older phường numbers. The usual night is here. A night at ấp Mũi, xã Đất Mũi, is for a dawn inside the gate. The culture-office listing closes that gate at 18:00. A tour page closes it at 17:30. No hotel brand is a pick.

eat: Lunch is mangrove crab, steamed, rang me, or as lẩu cua. Ba khía muối is the small crab with hot rice. The food guide is the rest: mudskipper, the U Minh pot, grilled snakehead, Khai Long clams, bee-pupa salad, eel with nhàu leaves, and the bags to carry, among them Thới Bình mắm, Trần Hợi dried banana, and Cái Nước bồn bồn. No stall price was printed. Check on arrival.
interestsBody: Dining is mangrove crab and ba khía muối with rice. The food guide holds the mudskipper, the U Minh pot, the clams, the bee-pupa salad, eel with nhàu, and the bags.

Rừng đước is the Ramsar mangrove at the tip. Area figures are over 41,800 hectares on the conservation page and 41,862 hectares on the Ramsar sheet. Designation dates printed for the site are 13/12/12, 27 November 2012, 2013, and 12 December 2013.
Hòn Đá Bạc is the granite on the Gulf. Khai Long is the clam flat, not a towered shore. Hòn Khoai sits offshore in the reserve.
Năm Căn is the fishing town on the way south. The city night is the river. U Minh Hạ is peat and melaleuca north of the city, a different gate from the cape.

body: The Ngọc Hiển page says meat crab is firm and sweet and roe crab is full and rich. Order it steamed, rang me, or as lẩu cua. Ba khía eats fallen mắm fruit, so the meat is firm and the roe is scant. The salted form is the one that page calls famous, with hot rice. The same page also names hấp, rang me, and nướng.

Người Lao Động on 29 December 2019 says the crabs gather around the tenth lunar month. Muối ba khía and gác kèo ong were named national intangible heritage. The next solar date is check on arrival. No stall price was printed.

body: Báo Đầu tư on 29 November 2023 prints 58.7 km from cầu Ông Tình at Năm Căn to the Đất Mũi gate. That project starts here, not in the city. A tour page prints more than 50 km and more than 1 hour on Quốc lộ 1 to the town, then more than 50 km on the Hồ Chí Minh road. A Vietravel page says the cape is more than 100 km from the city.

The market is the stop if you are already in town. A market hour was not printed. Check on arrival. Sông Đốc, on the west coast, is the Nghinh Ông port, not this quay. The 2026 rite fell on 2 April. The next solar date moves. Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Where should I sleep in Ca Mau?
faqs.a: In the city, in the river wards printed as phường An Xuyên and phường Tân Thành. A night at ấp Mũi is for a dawn inside the gate. The culture-office listing closes that gate at 18:00, and a tour page closes it at 17:30. No hotel brand is a pick.

faqs.q: Is a flight into Ca Mau running, and which clock is it?
faqs.a: The pages disagree, so check the airline before you count on a seat. VietnamPlus on 9 October 2026 says commercial flights resume 29 November 2026, Ho Chi Minh City to Cà Mau 12:50–13:55 and the return 14:50–15:50, at 924,000–964,000 VND. The ticket page, opened 22 October 2026, still lists the direct flight as operating, about 1 hour 10 minutes, once a day, with fares from 955,181 VND and from 1,206,000 VND. The 2025 airport guide prints VASCO at 11:25 outbound and 12:45 back, about 1 hour.

faqs.q: How long is the expressway from Can Tho?
faqs.a: The project board says 1.5 hours, from 3 hours before. The Tuổi Trẻ headline on 19 January 2026 says about 90 minutes. One driver that morning said more than 1 hour 15 minutes. The length is 110.85 km on the 19 January pages, and nearly 111 km of main line plus nearly 26 km of links on the 28 April notice. The toll was not printed. Check on arrival. The expressway ends at xã Hồ Thị Kỷ and does not reach Đất Mũi.

faqs.q: What does the Đất Mũi gate cost, and when does it shut?
faqs.a: The culture-office listing prints 15,000–30,000 VND and 07:00–18:00. A tour page dated 30 September 2026 prints 06:30–17:30, adult 30,000 VND, and 15,000 VND for a child from 1 m to 1.3 m or a student. The hours disagree. The office page does not split adult and child. Cart and canoe prices on the tour page are check on arrival.

faqs.q: Is there one entrance fee for Hòn Đá Bạc and for U Minh Hạ?
faqs.a: No figure is chosen. The national tourism extract and the relic page print no Hòn Đá Bạc fee. Two tour pages print 20,000 VND for an adult and 10,000 VND for a child, and one tour page prints 07:00–19:00. The U Minh Hạ homepage prints no fee and no hour. Commercial pages print 10,000 VND and 07:30–17:00, about 30,000–50,000 VND, and 07:20–17:00. Check on arrival.

season.label: Clams after Tết
season.note: The cape board says Bãi Khai Long, nearly 4 km and about 230 hectares, is busiest for clams after Tết through the end of May and June. The gate is daytime: 07:00–18:00 on the culture-office listing, and 06:30–17:30 on the 30 September 2026 tour page. Nghinh Ông Sông Đốc moves. The ministry’s 2025 peak was 11–17 March, equated to 12–18 of the second lunar month, opening the evening of 13 March. Báo Cà Mau printed 14–16 of the second lunar month, 13–15 March 2025. In 2026 the paper and the provincial police page put the 15th of the second lunar month on 2 April, the 101st time. The next solar dates move. Check on arrival. Dân trí, citing the 2026 provincial plan, places Nghinh Ông Gành Hào and Hương rừng U Minh inside 25–30 April 2026, and Festival tôm in November 2026 without the days. The Lạc Long Quân rite at xã Đất Mũi has no civil dates on the cape board homepage. A month when the road closes was not printed.
